question.problem:
$$
f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{2y}{{x}^{2}}+\frac{1}{2}, & \,1\le x\le 2,\,0\le y\le 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

The joint probability density function $f(x,y)$ for the continuous random variables $X$ and $Y$ is shown above. Given that 

$$
\text{E}[X]=\frac{3}{4}+\operatorname{ln}⁡2,\,\text{E}[Y]=\frac{7}{12},\,\text{SD}[X]≈0.2898,\,\text{SD}[Y]≈0.2764,
$$

 
find the correlation coefficient of $X$ and $Y.$ Round your answer to $2$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the correlation coefficient of the random variables $X$ and $Y$ is defined as

$$
\rho =\frac{\text{Cov}[X,Y]}{\text{SD}[X]\cdot \text{SD}[Y]},
$$

where

- $\text{Cov}[X,Y]$ is the covariance, and

- $\text{SD}[X]$ and $\text{SD}[Y]$ are the standard deviations of $X$ and $Y.$

First, by applying the rule of the lazy statistician, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[XY] & ={∬}_{{R}^{2}}xy\,f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{1}xy\cdot (\frac{2y}{{x}^{2}}+\frac{1}{2})\,\text{d}y]\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{1}(\frac{2{y}^{2}}{x}+\frac{1}{2}xy)\,\text{d}y]\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{[\frac{2}{3x}{y}^{3}+\frac{1}{4}x{y}^{2}]}_{y=0}^{y=1}\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}(\frac{2}{3x}+\frac{1}{4}x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[\frac{2}{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡x+\frac{1}{8}{x}^{2}]}_{1}^{2} \\  & =(\frac{2}{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡2+\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{8}) \\  & =\frac{2\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{3}+\frac{3}{8}.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we compute the covariance and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Cov}[X,Y] & =\text{E}[XY]-\text{E}[X]\cdot \text{E}[Y] \\  & =(\frac{2\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{3}+\frac{3}{8})-(\frac{3}{4}+\operatorname{ln}⁡2)(\frac{7}{12}) \\  & =(\frac{2\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{3}-\frac{7\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{12})+(\frac{3}{8}-\frac{7}{16}) \\  & =\frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{12}-\frac{1}{16}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correlation coefficient is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\rho  & =\frac{\text{Cov}[X,Y]}{\text{SD}[X]\cdot \text{SD}[Y]} \\  & ≈\frac{(\frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{12}-\frac{1}{16})}{(0.2898)\cdot (0.2764)} \\  & ≈-0.06,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to $2$ decimal places.
